model.title: Skills-Based Federal Contracting Act of 2025
model.meta: Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs Committee, Oversight and Government Reform Committee · Rep. Nancy Mace (R-SC)

summary.text: The bill would prevent federal agencies from requiring job applicants on government contracts to have minimum educational credentials—such as a college degree—unless contracting officers can justify why education is truly necessary for the position. It also directs the federal government to issue guidance encouraging agencies to consider work experience and skills as alternatives to formal education requirements when hiring for these contracts.
